title: Tech View groups work orders by lead technician and opens one
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (can edit work orders, sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: All tab, no filters, no search, display List, and no Tech View or Board View layout keys (no collapsed groups, pins or Tech View columns)
A throwaway customer with a unique name of at most 30 characters and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
Two eligible lead technicians A and B at this location, resolved over the API
Three work orders for that customer, each with one line: one with lead technician A, one with lead technician B, one with no lead

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders and pick Tech View from the display switcher
custom_steps_separated.expected: Tech View loads as one table of work orders under technician group headers, Unassigned first

custom_steps_separated.content: Search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Unassigned group header shows a count of 1, and the unassigned work order is the only row under it

custom_steps_separated.content: Bring technician A's group into view
custom_steps_separated.expected: The header shows A's name and a count of 1, and A's work order is the row under it, showing its work order number and the customer name

custom_steps_separated.content: Bring technician B's group into view
custom_steps_separated.expected: The header shows B's name and a count of 1, and B's work order is the row under it

custom_steps_separated.content: Click the unassigned work order's row on its Number or Customer cell
custom_steps_separated.expected:
That work order opens

Tech View lists real work orders under their lead technician's group header, the header counts match the rows, and clicking a row opens that work order
